threshold: ^The fountain is still. The water is not.
^Every story has already happened. Every story is waiting for you to remember it differently.
luna: ^You hear a melody before you see her. Luna does not lead you toward a perfect timeline. She teaches you how to hear the one that can still be mended.
^Look for Penny, the one who remembers.
fogg: ^The watch offers another attempt, but repetition is not repair. Fogg has administered resets long enough to know that every correction leaves a ghost.
origin: ^Energy can neither be created nor destroyed. It changes form. Aster's explosion, Quinton's divided soul, Martin's stolen power, and Luna's birth are consequences of the same wound.
penny: ^Penny cannot promise that remembering will save anyone. He can only refuse to let the lost timelines become meaningless.
convergence: ^Quentin is the catalyst. Julia sees the whole. Aster holds impossible power. Penny remembers. Luna navigates. No one is the chosen one; each carries one necessary part.

b: ^You recognize the pattern: continuity is a kind of magic.
^You feel the seduction of another reset—and its cost.
^You understand that power alone cannot choose its purpose.

false_ending: ^The world fractures cleanly. That is the danger of perfect endings: they erase everything that will not fit.
true_ending: ^The cycle cannot be broken. It must be mended.
^You choose one imperfect timeline, not because it is painless, but because the people inside it are real.
